sobre.titulo: Nice to meet you, I'm Benndy!
texto: I'm a digital artist and animator from Northeast Brazil. I've been introspective since I was 5, when I found refuge in drawing: a place where I could let my mind go to laugh, think or cry.

Unfortunately I never trained formally in art and, over time, my gift, as my family used to say, became a hobby. I lived happy moments and sad ones, until I found love. It didn't just open my eyes, it was also the catalyst for me to open up to others.

Over time, that boy who spent hours drawing at home gained friends, companions and recognition, and got back his faith and joy. Art was never just a hobby: it's my true essence, and it's what led me to my husband and my friends. Today I keep fighting for my independence and intellectual growth, to be the best for myself and for everyone I love.
destaques: Sketch, Flat Color and Full Rendered

perguntas.pergunta: Do I pay in reais or dollars?
perguntas.resposta: Clients in Brazil pay in reais (R$) and clients from other countries pay in US dollars (US$). Use the R$ / US$ switch in the prices section to see the prices in your currency.

perguntas.pergunta: How do I place an order?
perguntas.resposta: Build your order here on the site and send it on Telegram to @benndyTaxis, or message me on any of my socials. We'll talk about your idea before I start.

perguntas.pergunta: How does the sticker pack work?
perguntas.resposta: It's priced per sticker: you choose how many you want in the pack and the price follows the quantity.

perguntas.pergunta: Where can I see more art?
perguntas.resposta: On the Telegram channel Galeria Taxidermista and on my socials: Instagram, Bluesky and X.

texto: Soy un artista digital y animador del noreste de Brasil. Introspectivo desde los 5 años, cuando encontré refugio en el dibujo: un lugar donde podía soltar mi mente para reír, pensar o llorar.

Lamentablemente nunca me especialicé en el área artística y, con el tiempo, mi don, como decía mi familia, se convirtió en un hobby. Viví momentos felices y momentos tristes, hasta encontrar el amor. No solo me abrió los ojos, sino que también fue el catalizador para que me abriera a los demás.

Con el tiempo, aquel niño que pasaba horas dibujando en casa ganó amigos, compañeros y prestigio, y recuperó su fe y su alegría. El arte nunca fue solo un hobby: es mi verdadera esencia, y fue lo que me hizo conocer a mi esposo y a mis amigos. Hoy sigo luchando por mi independencia y mi evolución intelectual, para ser lo mejor para mí y para todos los que amo.
destaques: Sketch, Flat Color y Full Rendered
